faqs.question: What can I ask the AI assistant?
faqs.answer: Open the sparkles button on any dashboard page. A new chat has a Questions / Actions switcher with five starters on each side. Questions cover check-ins, occupancy, balances, maintenance, and what a status means. Actions can move a booking forward, re-check receipts, or cancel a booking, though risky changes still ask you to confirm first. Parking, inbox, and marketing aren't covered yet.

faqs.question: Can I attach a receipt or GAF in the AI assistant chat?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the paperclip next to the message box for a photo or PDF (up to three files, 4 MB each). Use the calendar button to pin a stay so the assistant knows which booking you mean.

faqs.question: How do I get a finance report to send to my accountant?
faqs.answer: Use Export report in the page header. You can export just the summary, just stays, just transactions, or a full combined report as a PDF for the date range you picked.

faqs.question: A booking showed up in my Finance list. Did someone add it manually?
faqs.answer: No. Every stay's income comes in automatically, alongside anything you add manually like expenses. You don't need to add booking income yourself.

faqs.question: Can I see guest stay payments on the parking finance page?
faqs.answer: No. That ledger is for the parking slot's own operating transactions. Guest stay payments stay under each property's finance module.

faqs.question: How do I create a new booking?
faqs.answer: Use New booking in the page header. It opens the guest booking form for this property.

faqs.question: Can I bulk-import bookings from a spreadsheet?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Import beside New booking (property bookings only). Upload a CSV or Excel file, or download your Google Sheet as Excel or CSV first, then confirm the column mapping and review the rows. Past stays commit as Imported; today and future stays show Pending Review but still appear when you filter by Imported. No new-booking emails or calendar events on import.

faqs.question: Can I go back a step if I made a mistake on a booking?
faqs.answer: Yes. Return to <step> at the bottom left moves the booking to a previous status. Existing fields and documents get reset, and no emails go out. It always names the step you're moving to and asks you to confirm first.

faqs.question: Why can't I cancel this booking?
faqs.answer: Cancelling is only available up to Ready for Check-in. Once a booking reaches Ready for Check-out the stay has already happened, so it gets finished or refunded instead of cancelled.

faqs.question: Can I close calendar dates without creating a booking?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select future available nights and choose Block. Guests cannot select or submit those nights.

faqs.question: Can I own two separate organizations with one Google account?
faqs.answer: No. Each account can own one organization. You can still be invited as an admin to other people's organizations.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Owner and Admin?
faqs.answer: Both can work across all properties and manage the team. Only the owner can change organization settings (including delete org) and add new properties. Admins handle day-to-day operations on existing listings.

faqs.question: Why does a team invite require a Gmail address?
faqs.answer: Hosts sign in with Google. The invite email must match the Google account the person will use to accept.

faqs.question: What happens if I delete the organization?
faqs.answer: Deletion is permanent and only allowed when there is no booking history (and no blocking finance or maintenance records). You must type the organization slug to confirm. Your Google sign-in account stays; only this org and its properties are removed.

faqs.question: Why can't I see the Add property button?
faqs.answer: Only the organization owner (and platform admin) can create new properties. Org admins can view and edit existing ones but not add listings.

faqs.question: Why can't I reply to some Facebook or Instagram messages?
faqs.answer: Meta only allows replies within 24 hours of the guest's last message. After that window closes, you'll need the guest to message you again before you can respond from here.

faqs.question: Where do I set quick replies and automation for Guest Inbox?
faqs.answer: On the property Inbox under Manage → Quick replies / Automation. Those settings apply across your organization.

faqs.question: Do I need to connect Facebook before I can publish marketing content?
faqs.answer: Yes. Connect your Facebook Page and Instagram through Guest Inbox first. Without that, you can still design and download assets, just not publish them from here.

faqs.question: How do I get Telegram reminders for maintenance tasks?
faqs.answer: Go to Notifications and open the Maintenance section to connect your Telegram bot and turn on reminders. The Maintenance page tracks the tasks; Notifications controls when alerts are sent.

faqs.question: What alerts does the Operations notification module cover?
faqs.answer: Booking workflow notifications: new bookings, status changes, and other admin alerts your team wants in Telegram.

faqs.question: Do I need a different Telegram bot for every notification module?
faqs.answer: No, one shared bot token is enough. Save it once at the top and each module can reuse it, or override it with its own token if you want. Use different Chat IDs so each module posts to the right group.

faqs.question: Can I turn off just one type of notification alert?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each module (Chat, Marketing, Staff, Operations, Finance, Maintenance) has its own Enable notifications toggle, so you can turn on only what you need.

faqs.question: How do I pick a Telegram group for alerts?
faqs.answer: Leave Chat ID empty, tap Scan for chats in that field, then choose your group from the dropdown. Add the bot to the group and send a message first if nothing appears.

faqs.question: How do I add a new parking slot?
faqs.answer: Tap Add parking (or use the + menu in the sidebar switcher), then complete setup on the new slot's settings page.

faqs.question: Is a standalone parking slot the same as parking tied to a stay booking on a property?
faqs.answer: No. These are standalone parking listings (tower slots, motorcycle bays, etc.). Guest stays that only need parking at a rental unit are still managed under property bookings.
